statement: The checked-in priority-recovery owner inventory is the exact deterministic projection of the current production recovery graph without source, generator, or baseline changes. doneWhen: solve/oracle/priority-recovery-owner-inventory-projection-refresh.json is done only when the official generator is idempotent, the focused owner-inventory test is green, and independent review confirms that only derived graph facts changed.
